[[Prismatic Staff]] is a [[unique item|unique]] [[staff]] obtained from the [[Prismatic Chest]], which appears after defeating the three [[Prismatic Ooze]]s in the [[Ooze Pit]].

==Stats==
:[[Energy]] +10
:[[Chaos damage]]: 11-22 (Requires 9 [[Energy Storage]])
:Halves skill recharge of [[spell]]s (Chance 20%)
:[[Energy]] +5 (while [[Health]] is above 50%)
:[[Health]] +60

==Skin==
This item uses the same [[skin]] as the [[Ether Staff]] and the [[Portal Staff]]   [[dye]]d white.

==Replica==
It is possible to create an exact replica for this item with:
*[[Ether Staff]] from crafters [[Asa]], [[Bolereh]], [[Derrick]], [[Rahmdah]], [[Sende]], or [[Soros]]
*[[Perfect]] [[Hale]] [[Staff Head]]
*Perfect [[Staff Wrapping]] [[of Fortitude]]
*Perfect "[[Inscription|Hale and Hearty]]" inscription
*White [[dye]]
